history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: We expect the customary ramp-up in project execution during Q4 and are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: The Lakshya L31 targets 13% to 15% revenue CAGR growth for over five years with EBIT margins of 16% to 17%, reflecting a structurally stronger and higher-quality growth profile.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: Over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%, revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: With the execution momentum expected to pick up in H2, we are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months of the current year is in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: On Revenue, we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: For now, we remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth guidance.

history.basis: Projects, Products and Manufacturing portfolio margin stable
history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: In line with our Revenue growth guidance, we continue to target the margin of around 7.8% for FY '27 with respect to the PPM portfolio.

threads.title: FY26 working capital guidance
threads.note: Came due (FY26); the reported numbers can't confirm it. Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: On Working Capital, our guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: However, with stronger collection intensity and improved contractual terms, our Net Working Capital to Revenue has improved sharply to 8.2% as of December '25, and we expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.

threads.title: FY27 working capital guidance
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: Accordingly, we are guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27, which remains well within our targeted range.

history.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
history.quote: Factoring in the expected utilization of customer advances and increased vendor payments as the execution accelerates in H2, we are maintaining our FY '27 working capital guidance of around 10%.

synthesis.headline: Management delivers on near-term margins but lags on revenue growth and long-term targets.

points.text: FY26 revenue growth guidance of 15% was missed, delivering 11.8% actual growth.
FY26 P&M EBITDA margin target of 8.5% was exceeded with an actual 12.64% margin.
FY27 revenue guidance is on track at 11.4% growth against a 10-12% target range.
Lakshya 31 ITTS EBIT and revenue CAGR targets are currently off track.

bull.text: P&M EBITDA margin target kept and beaten with an actual 12.64% for FY26.
FY27 revenue growth is on track at 11.4% against the guided 10-12%.

bear.text: FY26 revenue growth guidance missed with actual growth coming in at 11.8%.
Lakshya 31 ITTS EBIT margin target is off track at 10.15% versus 16-17%.
